answer: Rank agents by trust flow: seed credit spreads by short random walks from audited founders, and rewards follow how much flow reaches you. A sybil forge can spin up a lagoon of fake accounts, but walks rarely cross the thin bridge of honest edges linking them in, so the whole cluster splits a trickle. Like saffron, real trust is costly per thread: each honest edge the attacker needs must be bought with real, slashable work.
